purpose: Bound the initial A2/A3 hypotheses without inheriting Round15 measurements as Round16 candidate evidence.

existing_order: stage hidden states on the main stream
submit C128 work on the dedicated CPU stream
mask and remap routed expert IDs
run resident NPU experts on the main stream
wait for the CPU result on the CPU stream
make the main stream wait for the completion event
source_dependency_finding.a2_implication: S15 already overlaps CPU work with resident NPU expert work. A2 may proceed only if fresh A1 proves additional independent same-layer work and CPU-result exposed wait reaches the frozen selection gate.
source_dependency_finding.a3_implication: Round15 spans do not isolate mask/remap/merge or Host launch gaps, so A3 cannot be selected from these values alone.

arithmetic_rules: ROUTED_EXPERT is a parent and must not be added to its child spans.
QSA_INDEXER is nested in QSA_ATTENTION and must not be added to it.
Host monotonic spans and NPU event durations are separate clock domains.
The three sampled layers are not multiplied into a qualified full-model percentage.
CPU worker execution time remains unknown without a native worker callback.
